title: Polish Chicken Pierogi
description: A traditional Polish dish featuring chicken-filled pierogi served with a side of sautéed onions.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil.
Cook the pierogi according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, sauté the diced onion in butter until softened.
Add the cooked pierogi to the skillet and toss to combine with the onion.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Meanwhile, cook the chicken breast in a separate skillet until cooked through.
Slice the cooked chicken into strips.
Serve the pierogi with the chicken on top and a side of sautéed onions.
